visual.general_description: Composite of seven labelled panels, A to G: color photographs of the skin of an adult man (A and B back, C back, D chest and abdomen, G front torso) and two hematoxylin and eosin stained skin sections (E and F).
visual.detailed_description: Composite of seven labelled panels, A to G: color photographs of the skin of an adult man (A and B back, C back, D chest and abdomen, G front torso) and two hematoxylin and eosin stained skin sections (E and F). Panel A shows diffuse redness of the back with a printed date stamp; B shows many ring-shaped scaly plaques on the back and arms with a printed date stamp; C and D show multiple red ring-shaped polycyclic plaques on the back and on the neck, chest and abdomen; E and F show a thick surface layer, elongated epidermal ridges, small dark cell collections and dilated dermal vessels; G shows mostly clear torso skin with faint marks on the forearms. Panel letters are printed at the lower left of each panel.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of a back with diffuse red skin and a printed date stamp at the lower left.
panels.detailed_description: Photograph of the back of an adult torso from behind, shoulders at the top to the waistband at the bottom, filling the frame with diffusely red to pink skin with a fine speckled texture. A rotated red printed date-stamp overlay sits along the lower left edge. No head or face is visible and there are no arrows or scale bars.

evidence.quote: generalized pustular psoriasis

pixel_observations: Diffuse red-pink skin over the whole back with fine speckling.
Printed red date-stamp overlay along the lower left edge.
Waistband visible at the lower edge; no face visible.

evidence.quote: Generalized tiny pustules with erythema (A)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors cite Figure 1A for the generalized tiny pustules and erythema with fever during the 2005 flare-up.

evidence.quote: generalized tiny pustules and erythema with fever and illness during a flare‐up in 2005 (Figure 1A)

limitations: Individual tiny pustules are not resolvable at this size; only diffuse redness and speckling are described.
The printed date value is not transcribed.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of a back and arms with many red annular scaly plaques and a printed date stamp at the lower right.
panels.detailed_description: Photograph of an adult back, shoulders and upper arms from behind against a dark blue background, the head cropped at the neck with dark hair at the top. The skin is red to pink with numerous ring-shaped and rounded plaques, several with whitish scale, and a large crusted or scaly patch near the lower center. An orange printed date-stamp overlay sits at the lower right corner. No arrows or scale bars.

evidence.quote: generalized pustular psoriasis

body_parts.visual_cue: Both arms at the sides of the frame

pixel_observations: Multiple ring-shaped and rounded red plaques with whitish scale on the back and arms.
Larger scaly patch near the lower center of the back.
Orange printed date-stamp overlay at the lower right; dark blue background.

caption_claims.value: Multiple erythematous, annular shape-like hyperkeratotic plaques with pustules along the edges after the first dose of Secukinumab

evidence.quote: Multiple erythematous, annular shape‐like hyperkeratotic plaques with pustules along the edges after the first dose of Secukinumab (B)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors cite Figure 1B for the lesions that changed from erythema to annular hyperkeratotic plaques with edge pustules after secukinumab and acitretin were started.

evidence.quote: his skin lesions transitioned from erythema to annular hyperkeratotic plaques with pustules along the edges (Figure 1B)

limitations: Pustules along plaque edges are not individually resolvable at this size.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of a back with multiple red ring-shaped plaques.
panels.detailed_description: Photograph of an adult back and upper arms from behind against a yellow-tan background, head cropped above the shoulders. No printed text, arrows or scale bars.

evidence.quote: generalized pustular psoriasis

evidence.quote: Annular pustular plaque subsided with post‐inflammatory pigmentation after Secukinumab prescription (G)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors cite Figure 1G for resolution of the pustules and desquamating plaques after secukinumab was introduced.
